title: The site context says the design-system library is off before the first step
steps: S1: read the switches and the library at Tracy, with the library shown, not shown, unreadable and with no origin.
S2: build the site context with the library read off, and read on.
expect: S1: library is true only for a plain shown:true.
S2: off adds "- Design systems: OFF" telling the agent to read nothing of the site first, naming no tool; on adds nothing.
evidence: Issue #259: a design request read the site for ~48 s before the library refused DESIGN_SYSTEMS_OFF

tests: the switch is read at Tracy; off, unreadable or no origin is OFF
the site context says the design-system library is off before the first step, and only when read off (#259)
